about_the_game:
Master the Blade, Uncover Your Purpose

In The Lone Sword, you are the Sword—a sentient blade on a journey to uncover your Maker and the meaning of existence. This narrative platformer combines unique swordplay mechanics with puzzle-based exploration, inviting you to reflect on profound philosophical questions while navigating a nostalgic, stylized world.

A World of Mystery and Nostalgia

Explore the depths of a semi-open castle filled with intricate puzzles, hidden paths, and atmospheric charm. Every corner of this timeless world evokes the feeling of classic platformers while offering modern design elements to engage your curiosity and imagination.

Your Journey Awaits

Step into the world of The Lone Sword—where every swing of the blade uncovers deeper truths. Are you ready to wield the Sword and discover your purpose?

Unique Gameplay Features

  • Sword as Protagonist: Experience gameplay where the Sword is not just a weapon but the heart of the story—each swing and movement reflects your mastery and purpose.

  • Puzzle-Based Exploration: Traverse a semi-open castle, solving puzzles and uncovering secrets as you progress through a narrative-rich world.

  • Narrative Depth: Immerse yourself in a tale that explores themes of identity, creation, and purpose, leaving the ultimate question open to your interpretation.

  • Stylized Art Direction: Delight in a minimalist yet evocative art style that brings the Sword’s journey and the castle’s mystery to life.

What is in the Demo?

We offer you the experience of the first levels so you can immerse yourself in the world of The Lone Sword. The Demo showcases the game's beginning with the final quality of the actual product. It allows you to experience all of the early gameplay mechanics and learn what the story is about.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 or newer, SteamOS 3.0 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5, AMD FX
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulcan-capable GPU
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires an Apple processor
  • OS: Monterey 12 or newer
  • Processor: Apple M1 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 or better
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: The Lone Sword is a narrative platformer where a sentient Sword embarks on a nostalgic journey to uncover its Maker. Explore the Castle, solve puzzles, master the blade to wield unique sword mechanics, and reflect on the purpose of this emotionally rich adventure.
